basic_profile.bio: A recent college graduate based in Austin, Texas, working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in interior design and fashion, often spending my evenings browsing through online stores and fashion blogs. I live with my two younger sisters, and our new Maltipoo puppy has become the center of our household. I love playing Animal Crossing in my downtime and trade villagers frequently. I'm currently single and enjoy late-night online sessions as my work schedule is quite flexible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of formal education in design and self-taught skills in digital illustration. I have recently started learning about puppy training through online articles and community forums, as we have a new puppy at home.
